sentences.text: In Mainz-Bingen 126 reports have been logged over ten years, with the peak time spanning Apr–May and Jul–Oct.
The Small Copper has been recorded visiting the flowers of Tansy, Heather, Daisy and Creeping Thistle.
It has also been recorded visiting the flowers of Bloodwort, Oregano, Field Eryngo and Common Ragwort.
